component_overlap_definition: fraction of each predicted component's voxels overlapping the same-class ground-truth mask
false_positive_definition: predicted class voxels outside the same-class ground-truth mask
lung_region_analysis: not performed; no independently validated lung mask was supplied
limitations: Connected components are digital objects, not anatomical branches.
Zero same-class overlap does not prove a component is outside the lungs.
No components were removed and no predictions were modified.
No model, threshold, or post-processing tuning was performed.
